WhatsApp places multiple user accounts, including in India, under 24-hour review

WhatsApp has placed numerous user accounts, including those in India, under a 24-hour review process. Users reported their accounts were unexpectedly flagged without prior notice, preventing them from using the service during the review. The company stated that account activity and device information were being checked. This action has led to user complaints and confusion regarding the sudden restrictions.
